plain: A former Marine named Michael Herrera says that in 2009 his unit, which was meant to go to the Philippines on a mission the podcast host Jesse Michels calls Operation Katana, was sent instead to Indonesia, and that from the Navy ship USS Denver they went ashore in Sumatra. There, he says, they came across an eight-sided craft about 300 feet across and a team of armed men dressed all in black, who took the Marines' weapons, ran a "bio scanner" over them and held them at gunpoint, while two of the men talked about killing them. Herrera tells it as proof of a hidden human group flying a craft built from technology that is not human, though people retelling it differ on details such as the year and what the craft was carrying.
